newsitem.title: USA: AMEX lists "MITTS" on healthcare/biotech index.
newsitem.headline: AMEX lists "MITTS" on healthcare/biotech index.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said Friday it listed Market Index Target-Term Securities (MITTS) on Merrill Lynch's Healthcare/Biotechnology Portfolio.

The five-year securities were issued at $10 each and allow upward participation in a portfolio of healthcare and biotechnology stocks as well as an assurance of 100 percent principal return at maturity on October 31, 2001, the exchange said in a statement.
The specialist unit for the new securities is Kalb, Voorhis & Co.
The healthcare/biotechnology MITTS are based on the underlying index value of Merrill's Healthcare/Biotechnology Portfolio .MXH.
The index currently includes such stocks as Amgen Inc and Johnson & Johnson.
When the MITTS mature, holders will be entitled to the principal amount.

But if the index has risen by more than 15 percent from its initial spot level of 100, the holder will be entitled to the principal amount plus a supplemental amount determined by multiplying the percentage gain by the principal amount.
